answer: The BCA programme at CSIBER is a 3-year full-time course spread across 6 semesters.
You need to maintain a minimum of 80% attendance to safely appear for examinations. Use the Attendance Guard tool on this platform to calculate your safe leaves.
SGPA is calculated as Σ(Credit × Grade Point) / Σ(Credits). You can use the built-in SGPA/CGPA tools in CSIBER//ONE for instant calculations.
CSIBER//ONE was architected and developed by Anuj Gupta (BCA • CSIBER) as a digital utility layer for students.
